name: Heroku Postgres
line: Managed PostgreSQL with vector search and several database plan tiers.

free.text: No free plan; student credit $13/mo; billed idle; deprovision removes DB

cells.regions: Essential in US East or EU West; Private Space adds regions

sql.math: Essential-1 is $9 a month. The exact total also depends on egress (outbound data), which is not priced, and on compute capacity that has not been verified.
The idle database keeps its Essential-1 plan at $9 a month. How 730 hours are billed for part of a month depends on billing dates.

files.math: Heroku Postgres is a database, not file storage.

jobs.math: Postgres stores app data, but does not run the app worker.
